title: Radhaa Publishing House Presents: The Highly Anticipated Paperback Release of Maharlika: In Search of Identity by Deo Palma
text:
Radhaa Publishing House proudly announces the release of Maharlika: In Search of Identity by acclaimed author and historian Deo Palma. This illuminating work takes readers on a transformative journey through the depths of the Philippine archipelago’s true heritage — one that predates colonial rule and is deeply rooted in the spiritual and cultural fabric of Maharlika, the land’s original name.
For millennia, the islands known today as the Philippines served as a vibrant crossroads of civilizations, where diverse peoples converged, exchanged knowledge and built a society rich in tradition and identity. In this meticulously researched book, Palma unravels the complex and often overlooked history that shaped the Filipino people — beginning with an era of peaceful migration and cultural fusion, followed by a turbulent period of conquest and forced transformation.
A Forgotten Legacy, A Rediscovered Truth
At the heart of Maharlika: In Search of Identity is the profound spiritual and historical significance of the name “Maharlika.” Derived from Sanskrit, meaning “Great Creation,” the term speaks to a time when the islands thrived as a spiritual and cultural beacon in Southeast Asia. Citing the teachings of ascended Indian Master Shrii Shrii Anandamurti, Palma reveals that “Maharlika” was inscribed in the sacred archives of the spiritual realm long before it became a recognized landmark — a powerful testament to the nation’s divine legacy.
The book delves into the rich mosaic of indigenous groups, to waves of settlers from Indonesia, Malaysia, China, India, and the Arab world. Each civilization left its imprint on language, commerce, customs, and spirituality, forming a distinct yet interconnected identity. However, this organic evolution was violently disrupted by centuries of Spanish, British, Dutch, American, and Japanese colonization, leading to the loss of the people’s true name, identity, and sense of sovereignty.
An Author’s Lifelong Mission
Deo Palma, a dedicated historian, yogi, and social activist, has spent decades advocating for the restoration of the name Maharlika and the reawakening of Filipino consciousness. As the founder of The Confederation of Maharlika Society (Ang KaSaMa), he tirelessly works to revive the nation’s pre-colonial identity while fostering social and environmental change. His book is not merely a historical account — it is a call to action, urging Filipinos to reclaim their heritage, honor their ancestors, and redefine their national identity in a world that often seeks to erase Indigenous histories.
Palma’s work is deeply personal. With over 25 years of experience as a Yogi monk, he has dedicated his life to Universalism, meditation, and spiritual activism. His humanitarian efforts span continents, as he has taught meditation and yoga across Africa, South America, Turkey, Greece, Asia, and Europe. Yet, his ultimate mission remains focused on Maharlika, where he provides medical aid to indigenous communities, supports anti-human trafficking initiatives, and has established six daycare centers for working mothers through the Mahal Foundation.

A Timely and Transformative Read
In an era when nations worldwide are rediscovering their true histories and advocating for decolonization, Maharlika: In Search of Identity arrives at a critical moment. Palma’s compelling narrative challenges readers to reconsider what it truly means to be Filipino in today’s interconnected world. It examines the deep spiritual traditions that predate colonialism, the resilience of indigenous cultures, and the enduring struggle to reclaim a lost identity.
Radhaa Publishing House, known for amplifying voices that inspire global consciousness and personal transformation, is honored to bring this vital work to a worldwide audience. “Deo Palma’s book is a gift to the Filipino people and the world,” says Radhaa Nilia, founder of Radhaa Publishing House. “It is a powerful testament to the resilience, spirituality, and legacy of Maharlika. This book is more than history — it is a movement.”
Praise for Maharlika: In Search of Identity
Scholars, historians, and spiritual leaders alike have hailed Maharlika: In Search of Identity as a groundbreaking contribution to Southeast Asian studies, anthropology, and spiritual history. Early readers describe it as “a must-read for anyone seeking to understand the true essence of Filipino identity” and “a profound, deeply researched work that challenges the narratives imposed by colonial powers.”
About the Author: Deo Palma
Deo Palma is an accomplished author, historian, and humanitarian dedicated to cultural restoration, spiritual activism, and social service. His previous works include Maharlika: In Search of Identity (First Edition) and contributions to the Awakening Starseeds series (Volumes 2 and 3), as well as the poetry anthology Poems from the Heart.
As a lifelong advocate for Maharlika’s historical truth, Palma leads The Confederation of Maharlika Society (Ang KaSaMa), providing educational resources, medical aid, and social support to communities across the archipelago. His spiritual journey as a Yogi monk has shaped his approach to service, empowering him to guide others in their quest for self-realization and cultural awakening.
Palma’s work extends beyond the pages of this book. His humanitarian projects, cultural advocacy, and community initiatives rely on the generosity of supporters who believe in the restoration of Maharlika’s legacy. Donations can be made via PayPal to deopalma02@gmail.com, for those interested in learning more or connecting with Palma directly.
Maya Verzonilla, known professionally as Maya The Shaman, is a visionary healer, accomplished author, artist, and creator of transformative healing modalities. As the founder of Lemurian Code Academy, she developed two groundbreaking healing systems: Lemurian Code Healing and Infinite Cosmic Records, which bridge indigenous wisdom with contemporary spiritual practices.
A prolific author published by Radhaa Publishing House, Maya’s literary contributions include her pioneering work “Infinite Cosmic Records: Sacred Doorways to Healing & Remembering.” She serves as Lead Contributing Writer and Editor-in-Chief for “Maharlika: In Search of Identity,” exploring deep cultural and spiritual connections. Her expertise is further showcased in multiple collaborative works, including the three-volume series “Awakening Starseeds,” the bestselling “Energy Healing & Soul Medicine,” “Pillars of Light: Goddess Activations,” and “Poems from the Heart.”
Maya’s approach integrates ancestral knowledge with modern healing techniques, establishing her as a respected figure in the global consciousness and healing community. Through her work at Lemurian Code Academy, she continues to guide individuals on their journey of spiritual awakening, personal transformation, and profound healing.
From the Desk of Brilliant Futurist, Professor Shermon Cruz
I proudly endorse Deo Palma’s book, Maharlika: In Search of Identity. This work brilliantly explores the tensions, dynamics, and transformation of a nation searching for its Indigenous authenticity, spiritual identity, and future.
As an award-winning futurist, CEO, and Chief Futurist of the Center for Engaged Foresight, I recognize the importance of visionary perspectives in shaping national identity. In my role as Chair of the first UNESCO Chair on Participatory Governance and Regenerative Cities in the Philippines at Northwestern University, as well as Co-Founder of the Asia Pacific Futures Network and former Chair of the Association of Professional Futurists, I have dedicated my work to exploring futures that honor cultural roots while fostering innovation.
A Profound Exploration of Identity and Transformation
This book offers an alternative view of history, allowing for a deeper understanding of the pre-colonial past. The author emphasizes the Indigenous, Buddhist, Islamic, and Indic traditions that have shaped the nation’s cultural, spiritual, and political landscape.
By encouraging a broader, long-term perspective on history, Maharlika: In Search of Identity provides insights into the past, present, and future of the nation. It calls for a radical transformation, urging a collective re-emergence and the decolonization of self and identity. The book presents alternative ways of rethinking identities, politics, leadership, and governance systems, offering a vision for a more unified and culturally empowered future.
The author invites us to study Maharlika through historical, linguistic, cultural, mythical, and philosophical lenses. In doing so, we rediscover forgotten truths that have shaped the nation for centuries. This knowledge empowers us to address modern challenges with a renewed sense of unity, purpose, and cultural pride.
A Vision for a Cultural Renaissance
"The author refers to the Philippines as Maharlika, meaning “Great Creation,” advocating for a future where the nation may embrace this name change to honor its rich cultural heritage. This symbolic shift could ignite a cultural renaissance, fostering a deeper connection to ancestral wisdom and national identity.
What makes this book truly powerful is its call to action—a reminder that transformative change is not only possible but necessary. By restoring lost traditions, embracing collective wisdom, and shaping new governance systems, we are empowered to create a just and equitable future for generations to come.
As an activist and social welfare worker, the author believes in intentional living, strategic innovation, and the importance of spiritual action. He calls for honoring and invoking the blessings of our ancestors, asking them to guide us with universal compassion and love. This book serves as a profound invitation for individuals, communities, and nations to awaken to their highest potential—transforming from the inside out, rooted in ancient wisdom and contemporary consciousness."
Endorsed by Professor Shermon Cruz

Radhaa Nilia and Raymond Bagatsing volunteering in Maharlika Paradise.
Radhaa Nilia, founder of Radhaa Publishing House, first visited Maharlika Paradise in 2019, a sanctuary founded by Deo Palma in the heart of the Montenbal Mountains. During her visit, she witnessed firsthand the incredible community work Deo was doing—his non-stop efforts to protect endangered plants and animals, provide mass feedings, and support the education of Indigenous children. Deeply moved by his dedication, Radhaa became involved in supporting his mission and grew to believe in his work not only as a humanitarian but as an advocate for truth.
Radhaa believes in Deo Palma’s humanitarian work and recognizes that his book, Maharlika: In Search of Identity, plays a vital role in re-writing history back to its truth. Through his book, Deo aims to bring attention to untold narratives and reclaim Indigenous stories long obscured by colonialism.
She was introduced to the book during her time supporting his mission and saw the depth of its importance. Having spent a decade writing it, Deo enlisted the help of Maya the Shaman to make the book accessible for everyday readers. Together, they crafted a work that resonates deeply with those seeking to understand history from a truthful, indigenous perspective.
Radhaa Publishing House is a boutique publishing company committed to amplifying voices that inspire, educate, and transform. Led by women of color, the company specializes in holistic wellness, self-help, poetry, memoirs, and historical works that challenge mainstream narratives. Dedicated to empowering authors and preserving diverse cultural stories, Radhaa Publishing House continues to publish high-quality, consciousness-expanding books that leave a lasting impact.
